**New Features / Improvements:**

* Added HTTPS tunnel diagnostics with transfer statistics, upstream details, and connection errors.
* Added centralized data directory access for tray settings and log files.
* Added `Via` headers to forwarded HTTP requests and responses to comply with [RFC 9110, section 7.6.3](https://www.rfc-editor.org/info/rfc9110/#section-7.6.3).
* Added `--no-via` support to opt out of the [RFC 9110, section 7.6.3](https://www.rfc-editor.org/info/rfc9110/#section-7.6.3) `Via` HTTP header forwarding requirement as a compatibility override.
* Added `Host` header normalization to comply with [RFC 9112, section 3.2.2](https://www.rfc-editor.org/info/rfc9112/#section-3.2.2-7), which requires proxies receiving absolute-form requests to regenerate the header from the request target rather than forwarding the client's original value.
* Added HTTP header size boundary validation to enforced HTTP request and response header size limits.
* Added CONNECT destination port validation to enforced explicit, valid destination ports in HTTPS CONNECT requests in accordance with [RFC 9110, section 9.3.6](https://www.rfc-editor.org/info/rfc9110/#section-9.3.6).
* Added logic to reject duplicate, missing, or malformed HTTP Host headers in accordance with [RFC 9112, section 3.2](https://www.rfc-editor.org/info/rfc9112/#section-3.2).
* Added logic to reject conflicting HTTP message framing headers to prevent ambiguous requests and responses in accordance with RFC 9112, sections [6.1](https://www.rfc-editor.org/info/rfc9112/#name-transfer-encoding) and [6.3](https://www.rfc-editor.org/info/rfc9112/#section-6.3).
* Added logic to reject invalid, duplicate, and overflowing HTTP Content-Length headers to prevent ambiguous message framing in accordance with [RFC 9112, section 6.3](https://www.rfc-editor.org/info/rfc9112/#section-6.3).
* Added date and log level to console app logs.
* Added 256 maximum concurrent proxy connections limit with graceful overload rejection.
* Added `--max-connections` support for overriding the maximum concurrent proxy connections limit.
* Updated tray app log alignment and changed to [RFC 3339](https://www.rfc-editor.org/info/rfc3339/) UTC timestamps.
* Improved application metadata usage by removing more hardcoded product names.

**Bug Fixes:**

* Fixed a potential NullReferenceException during HTTPS tunnel shutdown by safely handling socket disposal when concurrent relay operations terminate.

**Known Issues / Limitations:**

* The Console app does not support saving proxy state across restarts, automatically starting at system login, logging to a file, nor checking for preview release updates. For these features and more, use the Tray app, which is better suited for these things.
* Microsoft Teams for work or school may disconnect when setting the proxy at the system level. To prevent this issue, add `teams.microsoft.com;*.teams.microsoft.com;teams.cloud.microsoft;*.teams.cloud.microsoft;login.microsoftonline.com` to the system proxy exception list. This solution is based on this [Microsoft Tech Community discussion](https://techcommunity.microsoft.com/discussions/teamsdeveloper/when-using-proxy-on-localhost-teams-fails-to-establish-tcp-connection-for-login/4146890), and it aligns with [Microsoft's recommendation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoftteams/proxy-servers-for-skype-for-business-online) for bypassing proxy servers for Teams traffic.
